,{"paragraph":11,"text":"金毛狐狐","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":16,"text":"大尾巴","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":17,"text":"整只狐","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":20,"text":"狐狐","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":25,"text":"金毛狐女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":28,"text":"狐狐","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":32,"text":"狐狐","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":33,"text":"小脚","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":35,"text":"身体","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":40,"text":"这副身体","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":52,"text":"金毛狐狐","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":55,"text":"狐狐","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":60,"text":"狐狐","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"OriginalOwner","mentions":[{"paragraph":40,"text":"原来的主人","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"Tainai","mentions":[{"paragraph":15,"text":"太奶","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":15,"text":"太奶","occurrence":1,"name":true}]},{"id":"Creator","mentions":[{"paragraph":66,"text":"造物主","occurrence":0,"name":true}]}],"disclosures":[{"id":"D1","from":4,"to":4,"text":"有一个声音要求说出姓名（【姓名。】）。","channel":"voice","mode":"question","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"D2","from":5,"to":5,"text":"苏天晴报出自己的姓名：“苏天晴。”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":[]},{"id":"D3","from":6,"to":6,"text":"昏暗的房间里传出清脆悦耳的女声，还有一道仿佛来自遥远彼方的低沉言语。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"D4","from":7,"to":7,"text":"苏天晴坐在床头，呆滞地看着飘浮在半空中的黑色古书，并从床边落地镜中瞥见一道陌生的娇小身影。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D5","from":8,"to":11,"text":"镜中/叙述中出现的是一只娇小的金毛狐女：金色长发、毛茸茸耳朵、精致五官、白皙肌肤以及正在炸毛的大尾巴，像是乖巧可爱的毛茸茸金毛狐狐。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D6","from":12,"to":12,"text":"古书含糊应声：“嗯嗯……这样啊……”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D7","from":13,"to":13,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回黑色古书。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryTome","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D8","from":14,"to":14,"text":"苏天晴有些茫然。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D9","from":15,"to":15,"text":"苏天晴回忆五分钟前刚下夜班，在街边面摊吃加了煎蛋的牛肉面；听到太奶在背后说话，回头看见太奶坐藤椅编围巾，随后胸口一疼眼前一黑死去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","Tainai"]},{"id":"D10","from":16,"to":16,"text":"苏天晴看着身侧摇曳的炸毛大尾巴，鬼使神差伸手用力薅了一把。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D11","from":17,"to":17,"text":"手上传来柔顺绝妙触感，随后尾巴被摩挲拉拽的感觉冲上天灵盖，两只耳朵竖起，整只狐绷直身体。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D12","from":18,"to":18,"text":"苏天晴心想：好真实的触感！","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D13","from":19,"to":19,"text":"古书问：“……你干嘛呢。”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D14","from":20,"to":20,"text":"黑色古书发出低沉言语，不太明白眼前这只狐狐为什么要用怪异手法薅自己的尾巴。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryTome","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D15","from":21,"to":21,"text":"古书心想：不疼的吗？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D16","from":22,"to":22,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声掩饰尴尬，让古书稍等一下：“咳咳！等一下，稍等一下！”","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D17","from":23,"to":23,"text":"苏天晴阻止古书继续说话，眼珠一转，飞快理清思绪。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D18","from":24,"to":24,"text":"苏天晴想：我重生了。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":[]},{"id":"D19","from":25,"to":25,"text":"苏天晴想：重生成了一只金毛狐女。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D20","from":26,"to":26,"text":"苏天晴想：眼前这本黑色会说话的书是怎么回事？有人能解释一下吗？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D21","from":27,"to":27,"text":"苏天晴扭头正视古书，茫然地问：“你是谁？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D22","from":28,"to":28,"text":"古书沉默了一会儿，像在思考眼前呆头呆脑的狐狐是不是自己要找的人，良久后重复开场白。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryTome","SuTianqing","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D23","from":29,"to":29,"text":"古书自称墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸远行至此，前来寻找最优秀的适格者。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D24","from":30,"to":30,"text":"古书称那个适格者就是苏天晴小姐。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D25","from":31,"to":31,"text":"再次听完这中二台词，苏天晴又陷入沉默与思索。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D26","from":32,"to":32,"text":"狐狐猛地从床上蹦下，走到落地镜前，沉默看向镜中穿着宽松睡裙的娇小身影。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D27","from":33,"to":33,"text":"她抬起一只脚，认真欣赏白皙软嫩带着红晕的小脚。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D28","from":34,"to":34,"text":"苏天晴心想：嗯，完美，绝品。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D29","from":35,"to":35,"text":"古书说：“看来你对现在的身体很满意嘛。”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D30","from":36,"to":36,"text":"古书语塞，憋了半天才冒出这一句。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D31","from":37,"to":37,"text":"古书问：“但是你为什么要盯着脚看？正常情况下不应该是……”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D32","from":38,"to":38,"text":"苏天晴回答：“你不懂，小脚才是世界上最美好的瑰宝，吃饭的时候看见了都能多炫两碗。”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D33","from":39,"to":39,"text":"苏天晴嘴上不搭调地回答古书，脑子里对现状有了大概了解。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D34","from":40,"to":40,"text":"苏天晴想：这本书知道自己并不是这副身体原来的主人，难道说……","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome","OriginalOwner","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D35","from":41,"to":41,"text":"古书说：“既然你这么满意，那咱们可以直接快进到下个步骤了。”","channel":"speech","mode":"plan","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D36","from":42,"to":42,"text":"古书将沉浸在欣赏狐狐身躯中的苏天晴唤回，苏天晴转身正视它。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryTome","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D37","from":43,"to":43,"text":"古书唤道：“听着，苏天晴。”","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D38","from":44,"to":44,"text":"古书称苏天晴是墨丘利秘典最佳适格者，自称为星界使者，会引导她走上完美生活，只需与她签订小小契约。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D39","from":45,"to":45,"text":"苏天晴说：“好，我签。”","channel":"speech","mode":"promise","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D40","from":46,"to":46,"text":"古书惊讶：“……啊？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D41","from":47,"to":47,"text":"古书凌乱了一下。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D42","from":48,"to":48,"text":"古书质疑苏天晴不按套路出牌，契约怎么说签就签，都不犹豫考虑一下。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D43","from":49,"to":49,"text":"苏天晴说：“这就是你思想狭隘了，小破书。”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D44","from":50,"to":50,"text":"苏天晴问：世界上最通用的愿望是哪两个。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":[]},{"id":"D45","from":51,"to":51,"text":"古书愣愣地反问：“……哪两个？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D46","from":52,"to":52,"text":"金毛狐狐俯下身子，伸出两根手指在黑色古书面前轻轻晃动，身后毛茸茸大尾巴也跟着摇曳。","channel":"narrator","mode":"description","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","FoxGirl","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D47","from":53,"to":53,"text":"苏天晴说：“取之不尽的财富！以及变成萝莉！这是世界上最通用的两个愿望！”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":[]},{"id":"D48","from":54,"to":54,"text":"苏天晴张开双臂，满眼放光。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D49","from":55,"to":55,"text":"苏天晴说：“变成萝莉本身就是最大的奖励，更何况还是这样一只可爱的狐狐！”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D50","from":56,"to":56,"text":"沉默。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D51","from":57,"to":57,"text":"古书并未因短暂错乱呆愣太久，迅速又将话题拖回正题。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryTome","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D52","from":58,"to":58,"text":"古书问：既然你答应，那我们之间的契约就算成立了？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D53","from":59,"to":59,"text":"苏天晴不假思索地说：“成立。”","channel":"speech","mode":"promise","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D54","from":60,"to":60,"text":"片刻后，狐狐突然反应过来什么，好奇地问。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"D55","from":61,"to":61,"text":"苏天晴问：“那个……我能问问契约的具体内容吗？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D56","from":62,"to":62,"text":"苏天晴心想：总不能是激活了什么奇怪的奴隶契约吧！那样的话可就亏大发了！","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D57","from":63,"to":63,"text":"古书毫不犹豫回答：“反派魔法少女。”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D58","from":64,"to":64,"text":"没有丝毫停顿，古书这般说道。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D59","from":65,"to":65,"text":"苏天晴：“啊？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D60","from":66,"to":66,"text":"古书说：既然契约已经签订，从今天开始苏天晴将成为魔法少女活跃于世，造物主为她量身定制一整套任务，帮助她逐步走上反派魔法少女的顶点。","channel":"speech","mode":"plan","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing","Creator"]},{"id":"D61","from":67,"to":67,"text":"苏天晴问：魔法少女是怎么回事？是那种死亡率高达90%的高危职业吗？","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D62","from":68,"to":68,"text":"古书说：“放心吧，是王道系的那种。”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D63","from":69,"to":69,"text":"苏天晴反驳：就是这样才不对吧！在王道故事里当反派不是纯纯的找死吗！","channel":"speech","mode":"denial","holder":"SuTianqing","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D64","from":70,"to":70,"text":"苏天晴突然有点后悔了。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D65","from":71,"to":71,"text":"苏天晴想：王道系是魔法少女们面对强敌逐渐成长，喊着友情和羁绊把反派干碎的故事；就算反派有系统有任务也很难在王道系故事里把主角干碎。","channel":"thought","mode":"reflection","holder":"SuTianqing","about":[]},{"id":"D66","from":72,"to":72,"text":"苏天晴想：我还能有反悔的机会吗？能不能把我送回原来的身体里？我觉得急性心肌梗死还有抢救的机会——","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianqing","about":[]},{"id":"D67","from":73,"to":73,"text":"【墨丘利秘典绑定成功。】","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["MercuryTome","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"D68","from":74,"to":74,"text":"脑子里响起的声音让苏天晴欲哭无泪。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D69","from":75,"to":75,"text":"【契约成立。】","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["MercuryTome"]},{"id":"D70","from":76,"to":76,"text":"【走上反派魔法少女的道路吧，苏天晴。】","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"request","holder":"MercuryTome","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]}],"beats":[{"id":"B1","from":1,"to":3,"gist":"章节标题、作者关于角色均已满18岁的声明与分隔线。","mode":"paratext","about":[]},{"id":"B2","from":4,"to":6,"gist":"有声音要求姓名，苏天晴回答“苏天晴”；昏暗房间中有女声和仿佛来自远方的低沉言语。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing"]},{"id":"B3","from":7,"to":11,"gist":"苏天晴坐在床头，看见飘浮的黑色古书，并从镜中看到陌生娇小金毛狐女形象；叙述描述其长发、狐耳、尾巴等。","mode":"description","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"B4","from":12,"to":14,"gist":"古书再次低声应声，苏天晴注意力被拽回古书并感到茫然。","mode":"narrative","about":["MercuryTome","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"B5","from":15,"to":18,"gist":"苏天晴回忆自己刚下夜班吃面、见太奶后胸口疼死去；随后薅自己狐尾，感受到狐身反应和真实触感。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","FoxGirl","Tainai"]},{"id":"B6","from":19,"to":23,"gist":"古书疑惑苏天晴为何薅自己的尾巴；苏天晴干咳制止古书、掩饰尴尬并理清思绪。","mode":"narrative","about":["MercuryTome","SuTianqing","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"B7","from":24,"to":26,"gist":"苏天晴意识到自己重生为金毛狐女，并疑惑会说话的黑色古书是怎么回事。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","FoxGirl","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"B8","from":27,"to":31,"gist":"苏天晴问古书是谁；古书自称墨丘利秘典，从星空彼岸来寻找最优秀适格者，并称那个人就是苏天晴小姐；苏天晴沉默思索。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"B9","from":32,"to":34,"gist":"狐狐从床上蹦下走到镜前，抬脚欣赏小脚，心想完美绝品。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"B10","from":35,"to":38,"gist":"古书调侃她对现在身体满意，又问她为何盯着脚看；苏天晴回应小脚是世界上最美好的瑰宝。","mode":"narrative","about":["MercuryTome","SuTianqing","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"B11","from":39,"to":40,"gist":"苏天晴嘴上回答古书，脑中对现状有大概了解，并猜想古书知道自己不是这副身体原来的主人。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome","FoxGirl","OriginalOwner"]},{"id":"B12","from":41,"to":44,"gist":"古书提出可快进到下个步骤，称苏天晴是墨丘利秘典最佳适格者、星界使者会引导她，只需签订小小契约。","mode":"narrative","about":["MercuryTome","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"B13","from":45,"to":48,"gist":"苏天晴立刻答应签约，古书惊讶并质疑她不按套路出牌、契约怎么说签就签。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"B14","from":49,"to":57,"gist":"苏天晴讲世界上最通用的两个愿望是取之不尽的财富和变成萝莉，并说变成萝莉本身已是最大奖励；古书沉默后把话题拉回正题。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome","FoxGirl"]},{"id":"B15","from":58,"to":64,"gist":"古书确认契约成立，苏天晴问契约具体内容，古书答“反派魔法少女”。","mode":"narrative","about":["MercuryTome","SuTianqing"]},{"id":"B16","from":65,"to":66,"gist":"苏天晴惊问；古书说明她将作为魔法少女活跃，造物主定制任务帮助她逐步走上反派魔法少女顶点。","mode":"narrative","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome","Creator"]},{"id":"B17","from":67,"to":72,"gist":"苏天晴担心魔法少女是高危职业，又认为在王道故事里当反派是找死，后悔并想反悔回到原来身体。","mode":"reflection","about":["SuTianqing","MercuryTome"]},{"id":"B18","from":73,"to":76,"gist":"系统/古书宣告墨丘利秘典绑定成功、契约成立，并命苏天晴走上反派魔法少女的道路。","mode":"narrative","about":["MercuryTome","SuTianqing"]}]}
